paite: Huchi in ka kihei a ni nuai a nuaisiahna hih a om tengteng ka mu a; huan ngai in, huchibang a nuaisiah a omte, lungmuanpa neiloute; huan amau nuaisiahte lam ah thilhihtheihna a-om a, himahleh lungmuanpa anei kei uh.
heading: Damsung A Hoihloute
english: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

paite: Huaiziak in misite asi khinsate adam lai dam a omlaite sang in ka phat zaw.
english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

paite: Ahi, a-om ngei nai lou, ni nuai a nasep gilou hih a om mu ngei nailoumi amaute sang in ka ngai thupizaw hi.
english: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

paite: Huchi in sepgimna leh nasep siamna tengteng, hiai ziak a mihing invengte hazat a omna ka muta hi. Hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
english: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

paite: Mihai in abante khepkhawm in amah sa ane hi.
english: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

paite: Khut dim nih sepgimna leh huih nungdelhna sang in, lungmuanna toh khut dim khat ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

paite: Huchi in ka kihei a ni nuai a bangmah lou ka mu hi.
english: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

paite: Amah kia a om khat ka mu a, nihna anei kei a; ahi, tapa anei kei, sanggampa leng anei kei; hinapi in lah asepgim tawpna a-om kei a, hauhsakna in amitte leng alungkim tuan kei hi. "Kua a dia semgim a, ka kha hoih tansak ka hia?" achi a. Hiai leng bangmah lou ahi, ahi, nakpi a gimthuakna ahi.
english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

paite: Khat sang in nih ahoihzaw; asepgimna ua ding a kipahman hoih aneih ziak un.
english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

paite: Puk le uh, khat in alawm phong ding ahih ziak in; himahleh apuk chiang a amah kia a-om a, amah phong ding midang nei lou tung agik hi.
english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

paite: Huai lou in, nih alupkhawm un, lumna athei uh; himahleh khat kia bangchi in alum thei dia?
english: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

paite: Huan mi khat in amah kia a om pen zouleh, nih in amah adou ding ua; khauzang guk a hek akitat mengmeng kei hi.
english: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

paite: Kumpipa tek leh hai, thuhilhna sang thei nawn lou sang in tuailai genthei leh pil ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

paite: Suangkul a kipan a kumpipa hi ding a hong paikhia lah ahi ngal a; ahi, ama gam mahmah a gentheisa a piang ahi.
english: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

paite: Ni nuai a vak ahing tengteng, tuailaite toh om uh ahihleh, anihna, amun ah adingh chih ka muta hi.
english: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

paite: Mi tengteng, amaute tung a a-omna mahmah, bei chih a-om kei a; hinapi in lah tunung chiang a hong om dingte amah ah akipak kei ding uh. Chihtaktak in hiai leng bangmah lou leh huih nungdelh lel ahi.
english: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
